body.name: explicit all-data pilot-local Jackson--factorial estimator
body.construction: Put \(L_d=\log(ed)\), \(m=n/8\), and \(K_d=\max\{2,\lfloor\kappa L_d\rfloor\}\). If \(d<D_0\), return \(\widehat V_{n,d}^{\mathrm{ER}}\); if \(d\geq D_0\) and \(n<d/L_d\), return \(1/2\). Otherwise draw \(M\sim\operatorname{Pois}(n/4)\), and on \(M\leq n\) mark the first \(M\) observations independently by \(B_i\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\), producing independent pilot and evaluation counts \(N'_{\jmath,x}\) and \(N_{\jmath,x}\); on \(M>n\), set the randomized output to zero. For \(M\leq n\), let \(c_{\jmath,x}=N'_{\jmath,x}/m\), \(h_{\jmath,x}=H_0\{\sqrt{c_{\jmath,x}L_d/m}+L_d/m\}\), \(\ell_{\jmath,x}=\max\{0,c_{\jmath,x}-h_{\jmath,x}\}\), \(u_{\jmath,x}=c_{\jmath,x}+h_{\jmath,x}\), and \(Q_x=\prod_{\jmath\in\mathcal J}[\ell_{\jmath,x},u_{\jmath,x}]\), with center \(b_x\) and coordinate radii \(r_x\). Expand \(P_{x,K_d}(v)-\bar f_\epsilon(b_x)=\sum_\alpha b_{x,\alpha}((v-b_x)/r_x)^\alpha\). Define \(U_h(N;z)=\sum_{t=0}^h\binom ht(-z)^{h-t}(N)_t/m^t\), \(S_x=(1+\epsilon^{-1})\sum_{\jmath}r_{\jmath,x}\), \(Z_x=\bar f_\epsilon(b_x)+\sum_\alpha b_{x,\alpha}\prod_{\jmath}U_{\alpha_{\jmath}}(N_{\jmath,x};b_{\jmath,x})/r_{\jmath,x}^{\alpha_{\jmath}}\), and \(T_x^{\mathrm{JF}}=\Pi_{[\bar f_\epsilon(b_x)-d^{1/4}S_x,\,\bar f_\epsilon(b_x)+d^{1/4}S_x]}(Z_x)\). The randomized statistic is \(\widetilde V=\Pi_{[0,1]}(\sum_xT_x^{\mathrm{JF}})\). In the Jackson branch define the all-data estimator \(\widehat V_{n,d}^{\mathrm{JF}}:=E[\widetilde V\mid O_1,\ldots,O_n]\), where the conditional expectation integrates only the displayed auxiliary Poisson count and marks.
